title: Smart Placement
description: Smart Placement is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.x that inverts the facing of directional blocks while sneaking, making observers, pistons, dispensers, droppers, crafters, and similar blocks much faster and more intuitive to place.
body:
Smart Placement makes directional block placement feel much less awkward in Minecraft. When you hold sneak while placing a directional block, the mod automatically inverts its facing, so observers can point toward you, pistons can face backward, and dispensers, droppers, crafters, and other facing-based blocks go where you actually want them.

The mod includes a live placement preview, configurable action-bar feedback, per-block toggles, and an optional keybind-based inversion mode if you do not want to rely on sneaking alone. It also comes with extra quality-of-life features such as scroll-based facing rotation, smart stair placement, and optional placement memory.

Smart Placement is designed to work well in singleplayer, on modded servers, and even on vanilla servers with a fallback placement method. If you build often with redstone, technical contraptions, or directional utility blocks, it removes a lot of the small placement annoyances that slow you down.
